_: THE FOUNDATION REGISTER — machine-readable domain facts for Dynasty Genius design work.
_standing_instruction: David, 2026-08-17: 'make this research really important for all Studio sessions'. Consult before asserting any football or model number. tools/foundation-check.mjs reads this file; it is the source of truth, and prose copies of these numbers are derived, never authoritative.

_grades.measured-in-house: Studio computed it from the app's own data, with controls run in both directions. Highest confidence.
_grades.published-primary: Traced to the original research, not a secondary article.
_grades.published-secondary: Widely repeated in the hobby; source is an article, not the study.
_grades.unverified: Encountered but not confirmed. Never quote without saying so.

corrections.wrong: yards per route run stabilises at 180+ routes / 11+ games
corrections.why: The ~184-route figure belongs to TPRR and ~188 to receptions-per-route; it was mis-attributed to YPRR. Studio's own split-half of the 180 bar returned 0.62 (~38% noise) on 912 player-seasons 2026-08-09, agreeing with the primary source.
corrections.source: Tuccitto split-half reliability, PFF 2007-13 (Intentional Rounding; recovered via Wayback)

corrections.wrong: the running-back age cliff is 26 (the value shipped in the product's code)
corrections.right: the wall is 29; 26 is barely distinguishable from 25 or 27
corrections.why: At 29: 92% of survivors decline, 14 of 27 gone the next season, median including the departed -100%. Measured in-house across 2018-2025.

corrections.wrong: the receiver age cliff is 28 (shipped in code)
corrections.right: the drop is at 27; receivers run above baseline through 26

thresholds.value: 20% clears WR2-or-better for 92% of finishers since 2006

thresholds.note: 'Stabilises' means HALF SIGNAL, HALF NOISE — it is not a green light. The hobby uses it as one.

repeatability.note: THE NAIVE BASELINE BEATS EVERY ADVANCED METRIC. An advanced panel must justify itself by explaining SHAPE, never by claiming better prediction.

age.baseline_note: The median qualifying player loses 17.1% of his PPG year over year AT EVERY AGE (n=956, all positions pooled). Read every age-decline figure as a difference from this. Most published age-decline numbers are measuring selection, not ageing.

measured.QB: UNMEASURABLE — too few per age-year in 8 seasons. A hole, not a pass.

age.design_rule: An age cliff is a CATEGORICAL LABEL ON A CONTINUOUS, NOISY QUANTITY and lies at the boundary. Draw the curve with its uncertainty and position the player on it; never a binary flag.

quarterback.trap: Every marquee QB analytic — EPA/play, CPOE, DAKOTA, time to throw — is PASSING-ONLY. A rushing yard is worth 2.5x a passing yard, and every QB1 since 2019 posted >=350 rush yards and >=4 rush TDs. In Superflex a QB surface built from those metrics ranks the wrong players.

superflex_qb_premium.note: FantasyCalc's is a FIXED multiplier applied to every QB — a model parameter, not a market observation. KTC re-crowdsources superflex separately, which also makes every NON-QB worth ~18% less.

dynasty_market.rank_vs_value: Values are NOT comparable across sources; ranks largely are. All three ecosystems agree a top-24 QB gains +40 to +45 overall rank spots going 1QB -> Superflex. Compare in rank space.

rookie_pick_hit_rates.note: Outcomes are step-shaped by round while the market prices picks continuously across the round boundary (1.12 -> 2.01 is only -5.3%).

dynasty_market.recency_premium: Normally nearer years are worth more, BUT it is currently INVERTED: a 2027 Early 1st prices above a 2026 Early 1st (weak 2026 class). Any pick model hard-coding 'sooner = more' is broken by construction.

our_model.what_it_forecasts: 2-year average PPG (per the published model card).

dvs_is_derived.formula: dynasty_value_score = projection_2y x per-position constant, clipped to [0,100]
dvs_is_derived.consequence_1: DVS carries NO information beyond the projection. It can be spoken as fantasy points per game — the hobby's own unit — with no modelling change.
dvs_is_derived.consequence_2: DVS is NOT comparable across positions: DVS 50 = 10.05 PPG for a QB but 4.70 for a TE.
dvs_is_derived.consequence_3: The clip at 100 pins the elite: 6 WRs (spanning 5.76 PPG of real difference), 11 of 89 TEs, 5 RBs. Our model cannot separate Ja'Marr Chase from George Pickens.

vs_market_ndcg_at_24.note: OUR MODEL DOES NOT OUT-RANK THE MARKET ANYWHERE. Behind at QB and RB, a coin-flip at WR and TE, on the app's own published backtest. No surface may imply our number should be trusted over the market's.

our_model.divergence_validity: None for all four positions — the gate that would establish that our disagreements are informative is UNEVALUATED. A divergence is an observation, not a signal.
our_model.board_movement: Scores changed on 2 of 54 capture days (2026-06-26; a 0.1-DVS twitch 2026-08-14). Our lane is a standing opinion, not a live one. Never draw it as moving.

category_conventions.boom_bust_is_rank_relative: 'Boom' and 'bust' are NOT fixed point totals — they are the average weekly score of a rank slot at that position (QB boom = 27.3+, the average QB3 week; RB boom = 19.4+, the average RB6 week). Position-relative, self-labelling, and it survives a scoring-format change. Independently corroborated by a second method built from 2025 season data.
category_conventions.uncertainty_is_never_drawn: FantasyPros prints uncertainty as four numbers (best / worst / average / std-dev) and draws it NOWHERE — no whiskers, no interval bars, anywhere on the product. The scatter-with-error-bars people associate with tiers is borischen.co, not FantasyPros. This is the strongest available argument for DRAWING the interval in a dynasty tool (and it agrees with craft principle 6).
category_conventions.ecr_is_two_different_things: A draft ranking is a consensus of 88 experts; a weekly ranking is a consensus of 8. Both ship under the identical label 'ECR'. Never treat the two as the same quantity.
category_conventions.staleness_is_first_class: FantasyPros shows per-expert freshness in human units ('5 h', '1 d', '2 w') and makes it SORTABLE — the most honest detail on any product in the category, and directly transferable to a product whose own lane has not moved since June.
category_conventions.no_single_rankings_column_order: There is a View: selector with five column sets; the default (Upside/Bust/SOS) is not the classic BEST/WORST/AVG/STD.DEV set. There is no TEAM column and no ADP column — team folds into the player cell and ADP survives only as an 'ECR VS. ADP' delta.
category_conventions.source: L1-standard-fantasy-football.md §8, read from server-rendered HTML and embedded JSON config rather than the rendered view

small_sample_rendering.shrinkage: (observed x N + league_average x S) / (N + S). Continuous, cannot lie at a boundary, and the gap between raw and shrunk IS the drawable uncertainty.
small_sample_rendering.savant_discipline: Baseball Savant nulls all 105 percent_rank fields when is_qualified = 0 and prints the words 'NOT QUALIFIED' — a categorical refusal, never a faded bar. Its axis reads POOR - AVERAGE - GREAT and colour is normalised so the hue means percentile, never magnitude.

unserved_data.note: The advanced-statistics layer is already on disk and reachable by NO api route.
